title: Fix paperless-ngx DNS resolution with ndots:2
description: Add dnsConfig with ndots:2 to paperless-web deployment to fix Alpine/musl DNS resolution issues. The musl libc in Alpine-based containers has known issues with Kubernetes default ndots:5 configuration. Reducing to ndots:2 allows unqualified service names like paperless-postgres and paperless-redis to resolve correctly.
close_reason: Fixed by adding dnsConfig with ndots:2 to paperless-web deployment

title: Learning: YAML structure corruption during bulk edits
description: During kompose label cleanup, YAML structure was corrupted: volumeMounts merged into resources section, empty selectors/labels left behind, and template labels mismatched selectors. Solution: restore kompose labels, ensure proper YAML hierarchy, match selector and template labels exactly. Prevention: validate YAML with kubectl --dry-run, test on one file first.

title: Document learnings: Kubernetes immutable selectors and kompose cleanup
description:
## Session Learnings: Immutable Selectors & Kompose Labels

### The Issue
When cleaning up kompose annotations and labels from deployments converted from Docker Compose, we accidentally modified the  labels in the Deployment spec.selector field. This caused ArgoCD sync failures because:

1. Kubernetes Deployment spec.selector is IMMUTABLE after creation
2. The selector.matchLabels must match template.metadata.labels exactly
3. Changing selectors causes "field is immutable" errors

### Root Cause
- The kompose tool adds  labels to both selectors and pods
- These labels are part of the deployment's immutable identity
- Removing them from existing deployments breaks the selector contract

### Solutions Applied
1. **Restored original selectors**: Added back  labels to selector.matchLabels and template.metadata.labels to match the original kompose structure

2. **Matched original structure exactly**: Some deployments only had  in the selector (no app label), so we matched that exactly

### Affected Deployments
- blog/blog-app-deployment.yaml
- immoly/immoly-app-deployment.yaml
- immoly/immoly-postgres-deployment.yaml
- jakob-lingel/jakob-lingel-app-deployment.yaml
- joy-alemazung/alemazung-app-deployment.yaml
- schluesselmomente/schluesselmomente-deployment.yaml
- schluesselmomente/schluesselmomente-backend-deployment.yaml
- uptime-kuma/uptime-kuma-deployment.yaml

### Manual Action Required
Some deployments (like immoly-postgres) were created with invalid selectors and need manual deletion:


Then ArgoCD will recreate them correctly.

### Best Practices for Future
1. Always check original selectors before removing labels
2. Deployment selectors are immutable - never change them on existing deployments
3. If selector must change: delete deployment → let ArgoCD recreate
4. Test kompose cleanup on a single deployment first
5. Consider using Kustomize/Helm to avoid label drift between apps

### Resources
- https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/#label-selector-updates
- ArgoCD will show "field is immutable" errors when selectors change
